This DHI package backports the upstream fix from systemd v258.9 (commit a8feb2f23565d39df5c90a753c851c1934a53117) before building. The patch rejects non-normalized cgroup paths in the systemd-oomd ManagedOOM varlink handler, closing the path traversal that allowed local users to terminate arbitrary processes.

The fixed release (2.8.0) cannot be selected for those consumers without also forcing the 1.x consumers in the same tree onto a new major line. Waiting for upstream to update dependency versions.

brace-expansion is a transitive dependency; the only fixed release (5.0.8) is in the 5.x major line, with no backport to the 1.x line, which ends at 1.1.17. Waiting for upstream to provide a fix for the 1.x line.

CVE-2026-56392 is an integer overflow in unexpand buffer allocation that multiplies max_column_width by MB_LEN_MAX. That allocation path was introduced after coreutils 9.7 (multibyte expand/unexpand support; first present in 9.11). Debian trixie and this DHI package ship 9.7, which still allocates with ximalloc(max_column_width) and does not contain the vulnerable multiply.
The DHI coreutils package backports the upstream uniq -w multibyte find_field() fix from commit d64e35a8a4c0e4608321433e0d84d917e4e36371.
